exposure: Prenatally diagnosed fetal hemivertebrae (single vs. multiple)
cohort: The study included 10 cases of fetuses diagnosed prenatally with hemivertebrae at a single hospital between 2007 and 2022.
finding: Multiple hemivertebrae were associated with other anomalies and poorer prognoses, while isolated single hemivertebra showed favorable outcomes and normal childhood development.
mod_finding: Mode of birth (vaginal or cesarean section) was determined by standard obstetric indications, not related to the hemivertebra diagnosis.
